news.analysis: Williams has had a nose for the end zone of late, recording one or more receiving touchdowns in four of his last six games. The wideout will look to showcase his explosive potential in a tough divisional matchup against the Chicago Bears in Week 12.

news.contents: Detroit Lions wide receiver Jameson Williams snagged all four of his targets for 93 yards and a touchdown in his team's 31-21 home win against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. Even against one of the league's most formidable units, Williams did what he does best -- get behind the defense and win the footrace to the end zone. news.analysis: Tucker led Las Vegas with 10 targets but caught just 20% of them. And 39 of his 50 receiving yards came on one reception. Meanwhile, Jack Bech caught eight of nine targets for 88 yards and a touchdown. The opportunities were there for Tucker in Fernando Mendoza's second career start, but the lack of efficiency makes him a volatile starting piece in fantasy lineups.

However, Harris was unable to repeat his performance in the Chargers' Week 11 loss to the New York Jets, recording just two catches for 28 yards on two targets. news.analysis: Kelce scored on touchdown receptions of eight and 22 yards in the first half. This ended a long touchdown drought for the veteran, who had not scored since Week 3. Kelce and the Chiefs will take on the Bills in Week 12.
news.contents: Travis Kelce caught 6-of-7 targets for 74 yards and two touchdowns in a 34-7 win over the Cardinals.
news.title: Travis Kelce finds the end zone twice in Week 11 win

news.contents: Kansas City Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce strengthened his TE1 case with six catches for 74 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 34-7 win over the Arizona Cardinals. He did all his damage before halftime, capping the opening drive with a third-down touchdown and getting behind the defense for his second score. Those were Kelce's first receiving touchdowns since Week 3. The bigger change for fantasy managers was how often Patrick Mahomes looked his way. Kelce led Kansas City in targets after ...
news.title: Travis Kelce Reasserts His TE1 Value

news.analysis: Sanders was perfect in the close win, adding field goals from 50 and 24 yards out. The veteran kicker has hit 27 of his 30 field-goal attempts and 16 extra points this year. He will now get ready to take on the Dolphins in Week 12.
news.contents: Jason Sanders made both of his field-goal attempts and added three extra points in a 27-24 win over the Chargers in Week 11.
news.title: Jason Sanders hits two FGs in Week 11

news.contents: New York Jets kicker Jason Sanders has made four field goals in three consecutive games, converting 12 of 13 attempts over that stretch. He is 25 of 28 on the season and has made all 14 attempts from inside 40 yards. Against Buffalo, he made two kicks from inside 30 yards and two from beyond 40. The longest came from 48 yards after the Jets stalled at the Buffalo 30. He also hit three from 48 yards or longer at Kansas City, including a 54-yarder. news.analysis: The almost 43-year-old Rodgers becomes the second-oldest player in NFL history to lead his team in rush yards, only trailing Tom Brady. After a four-game stretch of 11 passing touchdowns, Rodgers has now totaled four in his last four games. Rodgers faces a tough Denver defense on Sunday, where he holds no more than QB2 value.
news.contents: Aaron Rodgers went 30/44 for 227 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's loss to the Eagles. He added five rushes for 29 yards.
news.title: Aaron Rodgers leads Steelers in rush yards in Week 11's loss

news.analysis: Milton did just enough to end the Eagles' seven game losing streak. Milton has a much more favorable defensive matchup against the Cowboys on Thursday, but he isn't fantasy-relevant in one quarterback leagues.
news.contents: Joe Milton III completed 11/22 passes for 141 yards with no interceptions or touchdowns in Sunday's win over the Steelers. He also added five rushes for nine yards.
news.title: Joe Milton III secures first win as Eagles starter

news.analysis: Aiyuk is now expected to sign with the Commanders practice squad and re-unite with college QB Jayden Daniels. However, multiple WR needy teams could take the opportunity to take a glance at him, so don't be surprised if rumors abound. We'll get a much better idea of his potential fantasy value once he joins an NFL squad. He hasn't played since 2024, so a slow start would be expected, and his redraft value will likely be minimal, but taking a shot at the upside he might possess is worth it for those with bench space.
news.contents: Brandon Aiyuk has been released by the San Fransisco 49ers after a long standoff and holdout situation.
news.title: Brandon Aiyuk released by San Fransisco 49ers

news.contents: The Washington Commanders could offer pending free-agent wide receiver Brandon Aiyuk a spot on their practice squad, according to Ian Rapoport of the NFL Network. With their roster exemption expired, the San Francisco 49ers are releasing the former first-rounder on Monday, and he is expected to clear waivers. Rapoport believes that the Commanders are the most likely landing spot for Aiyuk, especially now that he has reportedly cleared any differences with quarterback Jayden Daniels, his ...
news.title: Commanders the "Most Likely Landing Spot" for Brandon Aiyuk

news.analysis: Engram led Denver in receptions, targets and receiving yards Sunday. The tight end had two receiving yards between Weeks 7 and 8 but has since caught 10 passes for 107 yards over his last two games. So, there are signs of life here. Engram is back in the streaming conversation heading into Week 12 against Pittsburgh.
